'''Close Combat Support''' is a [[support gem]] which grants the supported [[attack]] more [[melee]] damage based on how close the user is to the enemy. It also causes the skill to grant Combat Rush on hit, a [[buff]] which grants the next [[travel]] skill used within 2 seconds more [[attack speed]]. This support gem restricts the skill to [[sword]]s and [[axe]]s.

==Skill functions and interactions==
{{status
| name                   = Combat Rush
| type                   = Buff
| description = Your next Travel skill will be faster. Doesn't apply to skills supported by Close Combat Support.
}}
The "up to x% more damage" stat on Close Combat support (and the matching stat on the Slayer's [[Impact]] notable) applies the full damage bonus to targets up to a [[distance]] of 1.5 metres from you, then linearly scales down the bonus to 0 at a distance of 4 metres.<ref name="Oh Hi Mark" />

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.23.0|
* Quality now provides 0-10% increased Damage with Hits to Close Range Enemies, instead of causing Supported Skills to deal 0-10% increased Melee Damage.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.15.0d|
* Close Combat Support now has a Cost and Reservation Multiplier of 140% (previously 150%).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.15.0|
* Now has a 150% Cost and Reservation Multiplier (previously 140%).
* Supported Skills now deal up to 25-39% more Melee Damage to Enemies, based on proximity (previously 40-59%).
* Combat Rush now grants 20% more Attack Speed to Travel Skills that are not Supported by Close Combat (previously 20-24% more Attack and Cast Speed).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.7.0|
* Close Combat Support has been added to the game.
}}
{{Version history table end}}
